justification: A is a three-dimensional head with a broad brow ridge, deep-set eyes, nose and mouth, while B is a flat pillar covered in low-relief registers of animals (quadrupeds in profile, a bird with long neck and beak, a row of squatting/bent-legged creatures above a zigzag band); the only overlap is the presence of anthropomorphic/animal faces rendered in carved stone. The subject matter, the multi-register narrative arrangement in B versus a single isolated head in A, and the relief-versus-sculpture-in-the-round conventions differ almost entirely.
